Overview

São Gonçalo is a city in RJ with a population of 1,098,357. The second-most populous city in Rio de Janeiro state, a densely populated suburb with a strong commerce and service sector. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
